description: The 44 policy table fields and their hash, acc = 0 then acc = Poseidon(acc, fields[11c..11c + 11]) for c = 0..3. Fields are CRTB, list id and registry field per source slot, the private source's owner list mask and registry field, the rule count, 16 rule rows and zero padding to four rate-11 blocks. rule_parts splits each rule row read as one big-endian field from its low byte, subject, mode, mask and guard one byte each, the u64 threshold, then the alternative mask, every higher byte zero. Subject output_owner is 1, sender 2, asset 4, mode present 1, absent 2, guard always 0, above_amount 1, above_amount_by_asset 2, mask bit i is list i + 1. Produced by program-libs/policy/tests/policy_table_vector.rs.
